title: The grasshopper and the ant.
lines: A grasshopper is sitting in the grass.
He plays music all day long.
An ant walks past the grasshopper.
She's carrying a grain of wheat.
But she carries it all the way to her nest.
Why are you working so hard?
The ant wipes the sweat from her forehead.
I'm collecting food for the winter, she says.
In winter there's nothing left to find.
The grasshopper goes on playing his violin.
He sings a song about the sun.
She stacks the grains in her nest.
The leaves turn yellow and brown.
But his fingers are getting cold.
There isn't a single grain left to find.
He walks through the snow to the ants' nest.
Dear ant, says the grasshopper in a soft little voice.
May I have something to eat?
The ant looks at the grasshopper.
What did you do in the summer?
I played music, says the grasshopper.
She sees that the grasshopper is shivering with cold.
But in return you'll play music for us every evening.
He eats until his tummy is full.
And every evening he plays his violin for the ants.
In spring the grasshopper says: Now I'm going to work too.
Because I never want to be hungry again.
